justices.name: Maria Berkenkotter
justices.label: Fair-Bench Distinction
justices.narrative_note: Colorado's 2024 evaluation rated her high in every area - fairness, timely and well-grounded opinions, and leadership in court administration. 91% of attorneys and every judge affirmed she meets the standard. Her score reflects how she does the job, not how she rules.

justices.name: Susan Blanco
justices.narrative_note: Elevated to the Supreme Court in February 2026, so no appellate evaluation exists yet - her first retention is expected in 2028. (She met standards as a Larimer County district judge in 2020.) She'll be scored once the state publishes her evaluation.

justices.name: Brian Boatright
justices.label: Fair-Bench Distinction
justices.narrative_note: The 2024 evaluation found him meeting the standard, 3.6 out of 4 overall, with near-unanimous support from fellow judges; active in the community and mentors young lawyers. A softer attorney survey (79%) puts him a step below the top of the group.

justices.name: Richard Gabriel
justices.label: Fair-Bench Distinction
justices.narrative_note: The strongest survey on the current bench - 98% of attorneys, 97% of judges - praised for preparation, courtesy, treating parties equally, and clear, timely opinions. Based on his 2018 review, the oldest on the court.

justices.name: William W. Hood III
justices.label: Fair-Bench Distinction
justices.narrative_note: Called 'an asset to the Court, without reservation' - strong on courtesy, equal treatment, and clear reasoning, with standout work on the state's Access to Justice Commission, which lifts his access mark. Based on his 2016 review; he's up for retention in November 2026, when a fresh one is due.

justices.name: Monica Márquez (Chief Justice)
justices.label: Fair-Bench Distinction
justices.narrative_note: The 2024 evaluation found Chief Justice Marquez fair, impartial, and articulate, with clear, well-reasoned, timely opinions - 'an asset to the Court.' Built on how she conducts the work of judging, not the direction of her rulings.

justices.name: Carlos Armando Samour Jr.
justices.label: Fair-Bench Distinction
justices.narrative_note: Colorado's 2020 evaluation found him meeting the standard unanimously among commissioners - clear, engaging writing, timely decisions, and mentoring low-income students and immigrant communities. His attorney survey was the softest of the group (69%), on a small sample in his first retention review.
